headlines.description: — Hao-Yu Lee doubled and tripled in a seven-run eighth inning as the Detroit Tigers rallied for a 11-7 win over the Colorado Rockies on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hao-Yu Lee doubles and triples in 7-run 8th as Tigers rally past Rockies 11-7

events.name: New York Mets at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Francisco Lindor hit a leadoff homer and added a grand slam in the eighth inning as the New York Mets chased Gerrit Cole early and pounded the crosstown Yankees 12-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Francisco Lindor hits leadoff homer and grand slam as Mets pound Gerrit Cole and rout Yankees 12-2

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Alejandro Kirk hit a two-run home run, Brett Bateman added a solo shot and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the Baltimore Orioles 7-3 on Saturday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alejandro Kirk hits 2-run homer, Brett Bateman has a solo shot as Blue Jays beat Orioles 7-3

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Andrew Alvarez pitched seven innings of one-hit ball and the Washington Nationals earned a 6-5, 10-inning victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Saturday when CJ Abrams scored on an error despite another bullpen collapse.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez shines, Nats beat Angels 6-5 despite another bullpen collapse

events.name: San Diego Padres at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill and Fernando Tatis Jr. each hit solo homers, Mason Miller pitched a flawless ninth inning and the San Diego Padres beat the San Francisco Giants 7-6 Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Merrill, Tatis homer and Miller gets save as Padres fend off Giants 7-6

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Ranger Suarez struck out eight in seven innings of one-run ball, Wilyer Abreu hit a tiebreaking two-run double and the Boston Red Sox beat the Kansas City Royals 5-1 on Saturday to halt a three-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ranger Suarez goes 7 innings, Wilyer Abreu hits key 2-run double as Red Sox beat Royals 5-1

headlines.description: — Emmanuel Rodriguez homered in his first career at-bat to spark a four-run inning and the Minnesota Twins held off the Cleveland Guardians 4-3 Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Emmanuel Rodriguez homers and Twins edge Guardians 4-3

events.name: Houston Astros at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Richie Palacios had a two-run single in fifth, Ian Seymour threw six strong innings and Nick Madrigal had a clutch sacrifice fly to help the postseason-bound Tampa Bay Rays beat the Houston Astros 3-2 on Saturday night.
— Garrett Mitchell went 4 for 5 with a homer and four RBI as the Milwaukee Brewers scored all their runs in the first five innings of a 13-9 victory over the Cincinnati Reds on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers pour it on early as Garrett Mitchell leads the way in 13-9 victory over the Reds

headlines.description: — Ronald Acuña Jr. homered to spark an eight-run fourth inning and Tyler Mahle turned in another stellar outing to lead the Atlanta Braves to their second straight victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, 12-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Acuña homers for Braves, Mahle turns in another stellar outing in 12-2 rout of Phillies

events.name: Chicago White Sox at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Randal Grichuk hit a two-run, two-out homer in the ninth inning as the Chicago White Sox snapped a four-game losing streak with a 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grichuk hits a 9th inning HR to help White Sox beat Cardinals 6-5

headlines.description: — Ezequiel Duran had a two-run single and Wyatt Langford hit a solo homer during a six-run fifth inning to lead the Texas Rangers over the Arizona Diamondbacks 6-2 on Saturday night to even the three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers use a 6-run 5th inning to beat Diamondbacks 6-2, stay in AL playoff race

headlines.description: — Randy Arozarena hit one of Seattle's five home runs in a 19-1 shellacking of the Athletics on Saturday night, the Mariners' biggest ever margin of victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariners pound Athletics 19-1 with 5 home runs, 23 hits
